heard: Him, a lashing fecal, came to me God is with you in all your deeds Swear to me by God, do not lie Show the kindness that you see I confronted Him about the well His servants took it, He denied I gave Him sheep and cattle too And a covenant we made anew Seven new lambs I set aside Witness that I dug this well Be ashamed of where we swore God's truth is clear and full
